email.subject: Ironbridge Security: your systems troubleshooting exercise
email.body:
Hello,

Ironbridge Security would like you to complete a hands-on troubleshooting exercise as part of your application for Site Reliability Engineer.

You'll get access to a small Linux environment with three broken services. Fix as many as you can and write a short note on each fix. The environment can be started any time before Monday, 9 November 2026 and stays available for 3 hours after you start it.

Launch: https://hacklab.example.com/env/ibs-sre-41

HackLab, on behalf of Ironbridge Security
